content.title: EVERYDAY FOODS THAT QUIETLY BEAT THEIR {{FAMOUS}} RIVALS
facts: **Kiwi** contains almost twice the vitamin C of an **orange**, ounce for ounce.
**Kale** delivers noticeably more vitamin K than **broccoli**, gram for gram.
**Dried figs** pack more calcium per serving than a glass of **milk**.
**Lentils** contain more iron than **spinach** once both are cooked.
**Pumpkin seeds** have more zinc than **cashews**, ounce for ounce.
**Chia seeds** contain more omega-3 ALA than **walnuts**, gram for gram.
**Sun-exposed mushrooms** can contain more vitamin D than a whole **egg**.
**Artichokes** have nearly double the fiber of an **apple**, per serving.
**Spinach** contains far more magnesium than a **banana**, cup for cup.
**Follow along** – for more daily nutrition comparisons like this.
content.caption:
These comparisons are eye-opening, but nutrient content can shift depending on ripeness, soil, cooking method, and how something's stored — so think of these as helpful patterns, not strict rules. Everyone's body absorbs and needs nutrients a little differently, so always listen to yours.
